author: David Leisering
title: Jake McCarthy plays hero for Rockies on Monday night
desc: Jake McCarthy ripped a walk-off, three-run triple in the bottom of the ninth off of Aroldis Chapman to lift the Rockies to a 3-2 victory over the Red Sox on Monday.
impact: The game-winning triple was McCarthy's only hit in four at bats, but it was the biggest hit of the night for the young and improving Rockies. It was an even bigger hit considering Chapman was a perfect 14-for-14 in save chances and had allowed only two hits in 24 plate appearances against left-handed batters entering Monday. McCarthy is batting .367 (11-for-30) over his last seven games and is now hitting .294 with five home runs, 31 RBI, and 11 stolen bases in 64 games this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Mears (shoulder) plays catch Monday
desc: Nick Mears began playing catch again on Monday.
impact: Mears threw a bullpen session on June 16 but experienced soreness in his right shoulder. He received an injection and has since resumed playing catch. He does not yet have a timetable for his return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Carlos Estevez (shoulder) to throw bullpen session Wednesday
desc: Carlos Estevez is scheduled to throw a bullpen session on Wednesday.
impact: Esteves, who has been recovering from a right rotator cuff strain since March 29, threw a successful bullpen session on Sunday and is scheduled for another on Wednesday. If all goes well, he could advance to facing live hitters, with a return to the Kansas City Royals' bullpen expected sometime in July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kris Bubic (elbow) to resume rehab assignment Wednesday
desc: Kris Bubic is scheduled to resume his rehab assignment with Triple-A Omaha on Wednesday.
impact: Bubic, who was on a minor league rehab assignment while recovering from an elbow injury, suffered a setback with a shoulder issue on June 9. He received a clean MRI and threw a bullpen session without issue on Sunday. He is now scheduled to throw one inning with Triple-A Omaha on Wednesday.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Allen (hamstring) expected to begin rehab assignment this weekend
desc: Nick Allen is expected to begin a rehab assignment over the weekend.
impact: Allen is recovering from a Grade 1 left hamstring strain that landed him on the injured list June 8. He has progressed to taking batting practice and fielding ground balls and is on track to begin a minor league rehab assignment this weekend. He is expected to be activated from the injured list in early July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Braden Shewmake (adductor) expected to begin rehab assignment this weekend
desc: Braden Shewmake is expected to begin a rehab assignment over the weekend.
impact: Shewmake has been sidelined since May 31 due to a right adductor strain, but is on track to begin a minor league rehab assignment this weekend. He was batting .243 with a .665 OPS across 28 games for the Houston Astros before landing on the injured list.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Brenton Doyle (oblique) to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Brenton Doyle will begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Albuquerque on Tuesday.
impact: Doyle has been sidelined since May 20 due to a left oblique contusion. It remains unclear how many rehab games he will need before rejoining the Colorado Rockies. Doyle was in the midst of a down season prior to the injury, batting .207 with a .549 OPS across 111 at-bats.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jordan Beck (hamstring) to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Jordan Beck will begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Albuquerque on Tuesday.
impact: Beck, who has been sidelined since May 18 due to a left hamstring strain, is entering the final stage of his recovery. It remains unclear how many games he will need to play before being reinstated from the injured list.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kyle Farmer (forearm) to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Kyle Farmer is scheduled to begin a minor league rehab assignment on Tuesday.
impact: Farmer, who has primarily served as a utility player throughout his career, will complete his rehab assignment as a catcher in an effort to improve his chances of returning to the 26-man roster. He has appeared in 19 career games behind the plate.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Drew Rasmussen picks up loss despite strong outing
desc: Drew Rasmussen allowed two runs on four hits and two walks while striking out five over six innings in Monday's 2-1 loss to the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Rasmussen has a 2-2 record in June, but he has continued to dominate, recording a quality start in all four appearances while ranking third in the majors with a 1.00 ERA during that span. He has been one of baseball's top pitchers this season, posting a 2.62 ERA and 0.88 WHIP with 89 strikeouts across 86 innings. Rasmussen is lined up to make his next start on Saturday against the Arizona Diamondbacks.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Tyler Phillips delivers quality start Monday
desc: Tyler Phillips recorded his first quality start of the season in Monday's 4-3 loss to the Texas Rangers, allowing two runs on five hits and three walks while striking out four over six innings.
impact: Phillips threw a season-high 89 pitches and completed six innings for the first time this season. He bounced back nicely after allowing eight runs in his previous start against the Philadelphia Phillies. As a starter, Phillips owns a 4.94 ERA and 1.35 WHIP with 19 strikeouts across 23.2 innings. He is lined up to make his next start on Sunday against the St. Louis Cardinals.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Otto Lopez swipes bag in loss Monday
desc: Otto Lopez went 2-for-3 with a double, a walk, one run scored and a stolen base in Monday's 4-3 loss to the Texas Rangers.
impact: Lopez has reached base safely in 15 consecutive games, slashing .356/.400/.492 with six stolen bases during that span. He leads the majors with 103 hits this season and is tied for second with 21 doubles. Lopez continues to make a strong case for his first All-Star selection.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Manny Machado drives in lone run Monday
desc: Manny Machado went 2-for-3 with a home run in the Padres 1-0 win over the Braves on Monday.
impact: After hitting a go-ahead three-run home run on Saturday, Machado went yard again on Monday. It went on to be the lone run scored by either team on the night.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Miller records save Monday
desc: Mason Miller earned his 21st save of the season on Monday against the Braves.
impact: Miller ran into some trouble with two runners on and two outs. He was able to strikeout Mike Yastrzemski to secure the save.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael King tosses seven scoreless innings Monday
desc: Michael King allowed six hits over seven scoreless innings with five strikeouts in a win on Monday against the Braves.
impact: King posted his best performance since the middle of May when he threw seven scoreless innings against the Dodgers. He'll look to keep it going against the Dodgers again in his next outing.
